description: This file contains functions and classes for handling archive staging, including directory preparation, symlink traversal checks, and merging extracted files into a destination, with security measures against symlink attacks.

classes.name: ArchiveSecurityError
classes.description: Custom error class for archive security-related errors, including specific error codes for symlink and directory issues.

methods.name: symlinkTraversalError
methods.description: Creates an ArchiveSecurityError indicating a symlink traversal attempt.

methods.name: prepareArchiveDestinationDir
methods.description: Prepares the destination directory for archive extraction, ensuring it is not a symlink and is a directory.

methods.name: assertNoSymlinkTraversal
methods.description: Checks each part of a relative path to ensure no symlinks are traversed.

methods.name: assertResolvedInsideDestination
methods.description: Ensures a resolved path is inside the destination directory to prevent directory traversal attacks.

methods.name: prepareArchiveOutputPath
methods.description: Prepares the output path for an archive entry, creating directories and validating symlinks.

methods.name: applyStagedEntryMode
methods.description: Applies file mode permissions to a staged archive entry.

methods.name: withStagedArchiveDestination
methods.description: Creates a temporary staging directory for archive operations and cleans up afterward.

methods.name: mergeExtractedTreeIntoDestination
methods.description: Recursively merges files and directories from a source into a destination, with security checks.

methods.name: createArchiveSymlinkTraversalError
methods.description: Factory function to create a symlink traversal error.
